		Dataset details
	

Dataset type:
LLaVA-Interleave Bench is a comprehensive set of multi-image datasets that are collected from public datasets or generated by the GPT-4V API.
It is constructed for evaluating the interleaved multi-image reaoning capbilities of LMMs.
Dataset date:
LLaVA-Interleave Bench was collected in April 2024, and released in June 2024.
Paper or resources for more information:
Blog:… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lmms-lab/LLaVA-NeXT-Interleave-Bench.
evaluation_method: accuracy (automatic matching of predicted answers to references) and targeted human_eval for complex cases
reputation: Relatively new dataset that has gained attention in the LMM community for evaluating interleaved multi-image reasoning, but not yet a broadly established standard.
